authorship: Original proposal generated for this handoff; not a recovered historical or certified standards catalog.

pillars.title: Mandate and delegated authority
pillars.method: Resolve actual host permissions and parent mandates; compare each selected action with explicit scope and counterexamples outside that scope.

pillars.title: Beneficiary and problem hypothesis
pillars.method: Trace the problem to observations or explicitly hypothetical consumers; compare the proposed outcome against current behavior and the no-build alternative.

pillars.title: Value and outcome contracts
pillars.method: Create a before/after outcome contract with baseline, unit, observation window and disconfirmation; distinguish evidence collection from benefit.

pillars.title: Agent-derived intent and repository genesis
pillars.method: Reconstruct lineage without inventing history; compare repository separation to a module, package, existing owner, upstream reuse and no build.

pillars.title: Alternatives and non-goals
pillars.method: Compare feasible competing approaches against the same outcome and constraints; preserve rejection reasons and counterevidence.

pillars.title: Feedback and intent amendments
pillars.method: Classify feedback, preserve its source, apply actual authority, and compare prior and amended intent without rewriting observed facts.

pillars.title: Source provenance and acquisition
pillars.method: Inspect source records against accessible originals; verify identity, retrieval scope, versions and rights without fabricating unavailable content.

pillars.title: Claim analysis and contradictory evidence
pillars.method: Extract claims with source anchors; seek counterexamples and evaluate at least the serious alternatives supported by the decision context.

pillars.title: Research freshness and source drift
pillars.method: Compare current retrieval metadata with frozen source versions; record changed claims and invalidate only affected decisions.

pillars.title: Experiment design
pillars.method: Construct an experiment with competing hypotheses, observable discriminators, controls, budget and an explicit interpretation table.

pillars.title: Analysis and reproducibility
pillars.method: Recompute reported quantities from retained observations; repeat a bounded run and test a deliberately perturbed input.

pillars.title: Research-to-action decisions
pillars.method: Trace each adopted idea to the actual problem, bounded experiment, consumer and rejected alternatives; permit justified no-op conclusions.

pillars.title: Capability inventory
pillars.method: Enumerate actual entrypoints, exports, jobs, assets and dependencies using parsers and observed behavior; label inference and collection limits.

pillars.title: Requirement quality
pillars.method: Review each requirement against its parent outcome, acceptance oracle and scope; use counterexamples to expose ambiguity or conjunction.

pillars.title: Journeys and user-slice completeness
pillars.method: Execute the bounded journey from a realistic starting state through its final effect, including recovery and verification by a consumer.

pillars.title: Applicability and scope selection
pillars.method: Construct a capability-based applicability matrix; challenge both unjustified inclusion and convenient exclusions before freezing the epoch.

pillars.title: Open-world gap discovery
pillars.method: Compare declared, implemented, exercised and beneficial views; examine failures, implied obligations and credible alternatives within a finite frontier.

pillars.title: Delivery decomposition and backlog quality
pillars.method: Trace work packages to accepted outcomes and dependencies; compare completion evidence with parent obligations and integration boundaries.

pillars.title: Boundaries and canonical ownership
pillars.method: Map responsibilities, state stores, consumer paths and changes; compare decomposition alternatives using actual coupling and ownership evidence.

pillars.title: Interfaces and contracts
pillars.method: Exercise actual producers and consumers against versioned contracts, including malformed, older and partial messages.

pillars.title: Quality-attribute scenarios and ATAM-derived analysis
pillars.method: For each important quality attribute record stimulus, environment, affected artifact, response and response measure; compare alternatives and risk themes.

pillars.title: Failure domains and resilience structure
pillars.method: Inject isolated failures in disposable environments and observe propagation, containment, degradation and recovery across boundaries.

pillars.title: Modifiability and evolutionary design
pillars.method: Walk concrete change scenarios through code, contracts, tests and consumers; measure the minimal affected surface and compare simpler designs.

pillars.title: Polyrepo composition and integration baselines
pillars.method: Assemble the selected product from a pinned bill of materials; execute its cross-repository journey and deliberately mismatch one contract.

pillars.title: Core correctness and domain invariants
pillars.method: Execute representative, boundary and invalid inputs against domain predicates justified independently of the implementation.

pillars.title: Error semantics and defensive behavior
pillars.method: Trigger expected failure classes at public boundaries; inspect emitted errors, preserved state and the caller's recovery options.

pillars.title: Static quality and maintainability
pillars.method: Run the actual configured parser, type checks and linters; inspect relevant findings and sampled code structures rather than configuration presence.

pillars.title: Dependency and toolchain hygiene
pillars.method: Resolve dependency metadata and selected toolchain state; compare lockfiles, actual installed versions and supported upgrade boundaries.

pillars.title: Configuration semantics
pillars.method: Exercise precedence, validation, reload and failure behavior using synthetic secrets and isolated environments.

pillars.title: Concurrency and resource lifetime
pillars.method: Stress bounded concurrent operations with cancellation and injected failure; observe race safety, cleanup and stable resource counts.

pillars.title: Test inventory and behavioral coverage
pillars.method: Map tests to obligations and actual selected execution; distinguish source coverage, assertion coverage and consumer behavior.

pillars.title: Oracle and grader qualification
pillars.method: Run a valid witness and targeted invalid witnesses through the exact evaluator; preserve false-positive and false-negative observations.

pillars.title: Integration and end-to-end assurance
pillars.method: Execute real supported boundary paths in a disposable composition and inspect durable effects using an independent observer.

pillars.title: Property, mutation and fuzz assurance
pillars.method: Generate inputs under justified invariants, retain seeds and shrinking results, and measure whether meaningful code mutations are detected.

pillars.title: Test isolation and repeatability
pillars.method: Repeat and reorder tests in clean environments; deliberately contaminate one trial to verify isolation and reset behavior.

pillars.title: Regression and assurance change control
pillars.method: Compare prior and candidate behavior under a frozen baseline; exercise a seeded regression and inspect baseline-update permissions.

pillars.title: Clean checkout and setup
pillars.method: Start from a clean authorized checkout on the supported platform; execute the documented setup without developer caches or undeclared credentials.

pillars.title: Inner-loop feedback
pillars.method: Measure edit-to-feedback for representative changes and deliberately introduce known syntax, type and behavior failures.

pillars.title: Debugging and diagnostics
pillars.method: Reproduce representative faults and follow supported diagnostics from symptom to cause using permitted evidence.

pillars.title: Documentation and examples
pillars.method: Execute documented commands and examples from a clean consumer context; distinguish explanation quality from observable execution.

pillars.title: Contribution and review workflow
pillars.method: Follow a bounded contribution through claim, isolated change, review, integration and rollback; inject a conflict to test coordination.

pillars.title: Library and SDK consumer experience
pillars.method: Build a separate consumer project against the distributed package; test discoverability, compatibility and error handling without source-tree shortcuts.

pillars.title: Machine-facing discovery and interfaces
pillars.method: Use an unprimed authorized agent or scripted consumer to discover operations and parse outcomes; perturb arguments and schemas.

pillars.title: Headless execution and sandboxing
pillars.method: Run the actual workflow outside the foreground desktop under constrained native sandbox or VM permissions and synthetic fixtures.

pillars.title: Claims, leases and parallel work
pillars.method: Simulate concurrent claims, expiration, crash and takeover with unique worker identities; verify ownership and fencing at side-effect boundaries.

pillars.title: Restart, replay and durable memory
pillars.method: Terminate a worker at a controlled point and resume in a fresh session using only durable records and actual permissions.

pillars.title: Harness and tool qualification
pillars.method: Invoke the actual installed tool against valid, invalid, denied and timed-out cases; inspect raw effects and normalize only supported semantics.

pillars.title: Agent behavior and evaluation reliability
pillars.method: Run a frozen task set with independent reset, retained trials and outcome-based grading; report trial reliability separately from best-of-attempt success.

pillars.title: Onboarding and first value
pillars.method: Use a clean intended-user account and representative starting state; follow the first-value path without developer-only shortcuts.

pillars.title: Navigation and information architecture
pillars.method: Inspect task-oriented navigation using representative goals and rendered states; validate navigation effects through actual interaction.

pillars.title: Task execution and interaction correctness
pillars.method: Execute representative tasks through supported controls and verify state changes independently of visual confirmation.

pillars.title: Loading, empty and failure states
pillars.method: Exercise empty, loading, partial, offline, permission-denied and failed states with controlled backend responses.

pillars.title: Control, recovery and trust
pillars.method: Exercise undo, cancellation, confirmation, session expiry and permission changes; inspect what the user can understand and recover.

pillars.title: UX content and usability evidence
pillars.method: Review language against actual user tasks and evaluate task outcomes using appropriately labeled user or simulation evidence.

pillars.title: Keyboard and focus access
pillars.method: Traverse the actual interface without a pointer using the selected accessibility target; inspect focus, activation and escape behavior.

pillars.title: Semantic and assistive-technology access
pillars.method: Inspect the actual accessibility tree and exercise representative assistive-technology journeys against the declared conformance scope.

pillars.title: Visual access and adaptable presentation
pillars.method: Test selected text scaling, zoom, contrast, reflow and user-preference conditions on real rendered states.

pillars.title: Audio, timing and alternate input
pillars.method: Exercise the selected media and input alternatives; verify actual information equivalence and timing controls rather than asset presence.

pillars.title: Localization and internationalization
pillars.method: Run representative locale, script, timezone and formatting cases against real data exchange and rendered interfaces.

pillars.title: Accessibility assurance and scope honesty
pillars.method: Review conformance scope, instruments and actual journey evidence; identify automated coverage limits and required unavailable evaluations.

pillars.title: Design system and visual coherence
pillars.method: Inspect rendered examples across the selected product states; compare actual component usage to an accepted visual system and intentional exceptions.

pillars.title: Layout and responsive craft
pillars.method: Capture actual rendered states at the selected sizes and content extremes; assert geometry and inspect task-preserving behavior.

pillars.title: Interaction feedback and motion
pillars.method: Trigger interactions under normal and delayed execution; inspect feedback timing, interruptions and reduced-motion behavior.

pillars.title: Content density and visual hierarchy
pillars.method: Review real representative data with task goals; distinguish deliberate density from hidden actions, weak hierarchy or decorative noise.

pillars.title: Media, screenshots and product proof
pillars.method: Trace media to its capture or authorship source; compare claims with raw masters and verify allowed redactions and rights.

pillars.title: Polish review and craft acceptance
pillars.method: Use anchored review cases and actual task evidence; record concrete defects, disagreement and the effect of proposed changes.

pillars.title: Workload definition and measurement integrity
pillars.method: Inspect workload, hardware, toolchain, clock and sampling definitions; replay the measurement from retained raw observations.

pillars.title: Latency and responsiveness
pillars.method: Measure end-to-end and stage latency under the selected workload, including cold start and accepted contention conditions.

pillars.title: Throughput, capacity and backpressure
pillars.method: Sweep bounded load through the operating range; observe completed useful work, queue growth, fairness and saturation behavior.

pillars.title: Memory, storage and resource efficiency
pillars.method: Measure steady, peak and repeated-use resource behavior; inject allocation or storage pressure and observe bounded degradation.

pillars.title: Mixed-load and multi-device performance
pillars.method: Run representative competing CPU, GPU, storage, network and real-time workloads under authorized native or VM isolation.

pillars.title: Performance regression and economic efficiency
pillars.method: Compare matched baseline and candidate runs; include setup, verification, retries and useful outcomes in efficiency analysis.

pillars.title: Runtime observability
pillars.method: Trigger known operations and failures; follow metrics, logs and traces to actual effects with bounded and redacted telemetry.

pillars.title: Health, readiness and graceful degradation
pillars.method: Exercise startup, dependency loss, recovery and shutdown; compare reported health with actual ability to fulfill required work.

pillars.title: Recovery, backups and restoration
pillars.method: Create representative data, produce a backup, inject an authorized failure and restore through the supported path; compare integrity and elapsed recovery.

pillars.title: Incident response and operational learning
pillars.method: Run a bounded incident drill from detection through containment, recovery and follow-up; verify role routing and evidence retention.

pillars.title: Operations automation and change safety
pillars.method: Exercise scheduled and triggered operations under valid, denied and partial-failure conditions; inspect idempotency, receipts and rollback.

pillars.title: Continuity and long-lived service burden
pillars.method: Review actual service dependencies, expiry events, operating work and continuity scenarios; validate the highest-risk assumption with an exercise.

pillars.title: Threat model and trust boundaries
pillars.method: Map assets, actors, entrypoints and trust boundaries; derive plausible misuse cases and challenge assumptions with authorized tests.

pillars.title: Authentication and session security
pillars.method: Use synthetic accounts to exercise valid, invalid, expired, revoked and replayed credentials against actual authentication boundaries.

pillars.title: Authorization and tenant isolation
pillars.method: Exercise a permission matrix with synthetic principals across direct, indirect and cross-tenant resource paths.

pillars.title: Secrets and sensitive execution
pillars.method: Use synthetic secrets to inspect storage, logs, process arguments, artifacts and redaction paths under success and failure.

pillars.title: Input, protocol and dependency attack resistance
pillars.method: Run authorized malformed and adversarial fixtures against exposed boundaries; inspect containment and meaningful failure detection.

pillars.title: Supply chain, releases and security governance
pillars.method: Trace release artifacts through source, build and publication records; verify selected signatures and security workflows against actual receipts.

pillars.title: Data model and integrity
pillars.method: Create representative valid and invalid records and execute supported transformations; compare against independently stated integrity predicates.

pillars.title: Migrations and compatibility
pillars.method: Run supported upgrade and rollback sequences on representative old datasets; inspect preserved information, locks and partial failures.

pillars.title: Privacy and data minimization
pillars.method: Map actual data flows against purposes and authorized boundaries; validate the selected minimization and redaction behaviors with synthetic records.

pillars.title: Retention, deletion and export
pillars.method: Exercise retention expiry, scoped deletion and authorized export using representative linked records and derived stores.

pillars.title: Lineage, synchronization and reconciliation
pillars.method: Create controlled divergent updates and replay deliveries; verify identity, ordering, conflict handling and provenance.

pillars.title: Dataset and model-data quality
pillars.method: Inspect provenance and split definitions; run leakage, contamination, missingness and representative-query tests on permitted data.

pillars.title: Packaging and clean installation
pillars.method: Install the actual built or released artifact into a clean consumer environment; inspect contents, startup and uninstall behavior.

pillars.title: Release and artifact acceptance
pillars.method: Rebuild or inspect the release candidate, verify required checks and exercise the artifact promoted to the release channel.

pillars.title: Deployment and runtime publication
pillars.method: Deploy only within actual authority to a controlled target, verify routing and runtime behavior, and record honest blocked states for unavailable rights.

pillars.title: Updates, compatibility and deprecation
pillars.method: Exercise supported update and downgrade paths with representative user state; test version skew and deprecation messaging.

pillars.title: Documentation publication and discoverability
pillars.method: Generate and access the actual published output using explicit content allowlists; follow routes and verify source-to-page identity.

pillars.title: Adoption, support and consumer evidence
pillars.method: Observe an authorized real consumer using the delivered artifact; retain support friction, outcomes and evidence labels.

pillars.title: Record identity and schema integrity
pillars.method: Validate the actual record structure, identifiers and cross-references; perturb revisions, types and references to verify rejection.

pillars.title: Subject, evidence and report provenance
pillars.method: Resolve subject, report, artifact, evaluator and evidence identities; recompute local digests and reject incorrect bindings.

pillars.title: Scoring and maturity integrity
pillars.method: Recompute totals from the frozen assignment and effective result set; inject unknowns, stale passes, exclusions and gate failures.

pillars.title: Assignment epochs and self-amendment
pillars.method: Compare frozen and proposed baselines, qualify changed obligations and inspect amendment authority; preserve urgent-stop semantics.

pillars.title: Ledger, outbox and concurrency integrity
pillars.method: Replay, duplicate, reorder and interrupt deliveries; verify idempotency, conflict detection and honest local-versus-remote state.

pillars.title: Assurance boundaries and evaluator security
pillars.method: Inject forged records, untrusted instructions, altered fixtures and unauthorized effects; inspect actual enforcement and independent observations.

pillars.title: Stage and slice maturity
pillars.method: Evaluate the selected stage's conjunctive gates against actual current evidence; keep value evidence and readiness axes independently visible.

pillars.title: Portfolio allocation and lifecycle choices
pillars.method: Compare improve, experiment, narrow, merge, maintain, pause, pivot, retire and no-action alternatives under the actual mandate and resource envelope.

pillars.title: Retirement, migration and custody
pillars.method: Inventory live consumers and retained assets, exercise migration, verify custody and perform only authorized lifecycle effects.

pillars.title: Economics and bounded resource use
pillars.method: Collect actual worker, tool, runtime, setup, verification and rework observations; compare accepted outcomes under a declared budget.

pillars.title: Convergence, stalls and restart policy
pillars.method: Compare attempts under a fixed success definition; retain failure fingerprints, reopened defects and censored work, then classify stalls before intervention.

pillars.title: Lab autonomy and institution-level validation
pillars.method: Run a bounded no-platform vertical slice with agent-derived intent, qualified grading, an actual change or experiment, and a fresh-session handoff.
